import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
DB_PATH = 'projects.db'
ALLOWED_ROLES = ('viewer', 'contributor', 'admin')

def grant_project_role(project_id, username, role, granted_by):
    if role not in ALLOWED_ROLES:
        raise ValueError(f'role must be one of {ALLOWED_ROLES}')
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        previous = conn.execute('SELECT role FROM project_members WHERE project_id = ? AND username = ?', (project_id, username)).fetchone()
        conn.execute('INSERT INTO project_members (project_id, username, role, granted_by, granted_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(project_id, username) DO UPDATE SET role = excluded.role, granted_by = excluded.granted_by, granted_at = excluded.granted_at', (project_id, username, role, granted_by, now))
        # Move any pending access requests for this user/project into the archive table
        conn.execute('INSERT INTO access_requests_archive SELECT * FROM access_requests WHERE project_id = ? AND username = ?', (project_id, username))
        conn.execute('DELETE FROM access_requests WHERE project_id = ? AND username = ?', (project_id, username))
        conn.execute('INSERT INTO permission_audit (project_id, username, old_role, new_role, actor, at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)', (project_id, username, previous[0] if previous else None, role, granted_by, now))
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return {'project_id': project_id, 'username': username, 'old_role': previous[0] if previous else None, 'new_role': role, 'granted_at': now}
